copies_and_surfaces: DB primary + HA replica + PITR/WAL + backup + restored quarantine
proof_procedure: Enumerate logical rows by synthetic subject; case ID and per-copy work item; source query/hash counts; HA/PITR watermark; backup expiry; restore-quarantine query; replay deletion ledger; verify no subject rows before release.
lag_or_completion_detector: HA lag, PITR retention, backup coverage, restore point, replica status
required_receipt_boundary: Source/HA/PITR/backup/restored copy; deletion completion must distinguish active 30d from backup ≤35d
safe_evidence_content: No personal values in evidence; limited nonpersonal case ID + timestamps/counts + operator role
owner_questions_unanswered: DB logical delete, HA/backup expiry, deletion ledger permitted fields and retention all UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Current and noncurrent versions, delete markers, replicas, backup objects, multipart parts, CDN/cache copies
proof_procedure: List versions and upload IDs before/after; capture version IDs only if non-sensitive; verify replicated versions and deletion semantics, abort multipart, invalidate cache; reconcile destination inventories.
lag_or_completion_detector: Replication status/lag/errors; lifecycle pending; incomplete upload age
required_receipt_boundary: All source versions/replicas/backup copies and cache expiration
safe_evidence_content: Counts, opaque version refs, timestamps, result codes; no image bytes
owner_questions_unanswered: Residency, version retention and final purge semantics UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Identity provider account/profile replicas, sessions/tokens, provider backup/export
proof_procedure: Disable account; revoke sessions/refresh tokens; vendor delete request/status; probe authorization denial; verify account no longer resolves after vendor-defined window.
lag_or_completion_detector: Vendor job state, token revocation status, auth probe result
required_receipt_boundary: Identity service replicas/backups and active sessions
safe_evidence_content: Opaque synthetic subject, job ref, timestamps/status only

copies_and_surfaces: SQL outbox, queue, retries, DLQ, mail vendor acceptance log, recipient mailbox
proof_procedure: Relate outbox event to queue/message key; purge or expire internal copies; vendor deletion/retention terms; distinguish accepted vs delivered vs recipient-held copies.
lag_or_completion_detector: Oldest message age, retry count, DLQ count, provider acceptance/error
required_receipt_boundary: SQL, queue, DLQ, mail provider and recipient side where supported
safe_evidence_content: Nonpersonal event key/status and counts; no addresses or message body
owner_questions_unanswered: Recipient-side copy/retention/transfer and duplicate policy UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Ingest, hot store, archive/export, replicas, vendor support export, probe account
proof_procedure: Use synthetic subject/token canary search across indices/archives; verify retention expiration and delete workflow; include accidental-PII incident handling.
lag_or_completion_detector: Retention policy state, export jobs, index/archive inventory
required_receipt_boundary: All configured sinks, replicas, exports and backups
safe_evidence_content: Query predicates/results/counts; no matched values or raw payloads
owner_questions_unanswered: Location, retention and deletion capabilities UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Audit stream, deletion case/work items, replicas, backups
proof_procedure: Define allowed minimal nonpersonal exception record only after owner decision; prove case event chain, tamper controls and backup replay without retaining forbidden identifiers.
lag_or_completion_detector: Case age/state, unassigned work, missing receipt, failed reconciliation
required_receipt_boundary: Audit/ledger source, replicas, backups and exports
safe_evidence_content: Case ID, class, status, timestamps, aggregate proof refs; retention itself unanswered
owner_questions_unanswered: Whether ledger may retain linkage/exception and retention period UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Snapshots, PITR logs, object copies, region copies, restore quarantine
proof_procedure: Inventory every scheduled/manual copy, age, key, location and expiry; restore synthetic subject into quarantine, replay deletion events, prove absence before publication.
lag_or_completion_detector: Last good copy age, coverage %, replication watermark, restore validation
required_receipt_boundary: All DB/object backups and replicas; 35-day maximum age is requirement, exact lifecycle mechanism U
safe_evidence_content: Opaque copy ID, region label after decision, timestamps, coverage counts
owner_questions_unanswered: PITR duration, legal hold/retention exceptions and copy geography UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Key versions, wrapped data keys, secret versions, replicas, scheduled deletion state
proof_procedure: Map data class→key/version; prove rotation access and decryptability of retained required copy; prove deletion schedule/completion only after retention/recovery approval; alert before irrecoverable key loss.
lag_or_completion_detector: Key state, scheduled deletion timestamp, decrypt probe for synthetic record
required_receipt_boundary: KMS/HSM/service key replicas and secret manager versions
safe_evidence_content: Key alias/version identifiers only if non-sensitive, event times/state
owner_questions_unanswered: Key wait period, recovery point, provider backup and deletion terms UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: CDN/edge, application caches, browser/session cache, issued URL exposure
proof_procedure: Invalidate cache; wait for approved TTL; verify external synthetic fetch denied/expired and cache purge result; revoke signing key only if blast radius approved.
lag_or_completion_detector: Purge job status, TTL remaining, synthetic fetch result
required_receipt_boundary: Every cache layer and outstanding signed URL population
owner_questions_unanswered: TTL, cache geography, user-visible exposure window UNANSWERED

copies_and_surfaces: Provider audit/control-plane logs, ticket exports, support bundles and diagnostic snapshots
proof_procedure: Inventory and inspect a synthetic tagged record through all export paths; check deletion/retention behavior and vendor ticket handling; do not assume control-plane follows data plane region.
lag_or_completion_detector: Export inventory and retention setting checks
required_receipt_boundary: Provider/control-plane and support systems within vendor scope
safe_evidence_content: Evidence references only; no secret/person data
